questions.question: The method of inspection employed to analyse the strains in the part are:

explanations.a: Visual inspection cannot detect internal strain.
explanations.b: Ultrasound is commonly used for internal defect and strain analysis.
explanations.c: X-ray is mainly used for internal cracks.

questions.question: The joining technique which does not require accessories along with it:

explanations.a: Screwed joints require nuts or tapped holes.
explanations.b: Rivets do not require additional accessories.
explanations.c: Bolted joints require nuts and washers.

questions.question: This is not a case for type of rivet:

explanations.b: Hollow rivets are used for light work.
explanations.d: Tapered is not a rivet type.

questions.question: The operation is not be performed by:

explanations.b: Chemical means are not used in riveting.
explanations.d: Robotic riveting is used in automation.

questions.question: Riveting may not be done by:

answers.d: Using explosives in the cavity of the rivet

explanations.a: Rollers can be used in some processes.
explanations.d: Explosives are not used in riveting.
